data.title: Tesla Optimus production starts as Musk targets 20,000 robots weekly
data.description: Tesla has started Optimus robot production in Fremont as Elon Musk targets 20,000 humanoid robots per week by the end of 2027.
data.author: Aamir Khollam
data.keywords: Elon Musk, Humanoid robots, Optimus humanoid robot, robot manufacturing, Robotics, Tesla, Tesla Optimus
